title: Baste: No ‘Duterte’ name in GenCorp documents for Davao City deals

blocks.text: Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte said neither Vice President Sara Duterte’s name nor even the surname “Duterte” appeared in the official corporate documents submitted by GenCorp Industries Inc. in connection with its transactions with the city government.
